newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish cellular phone firm to launch services.
newsitem.headline: Polish cellular phone firm to launch services.

text.p: The cellular telephone consortium of Polish and foreign firms PTC Era GSM (Era) will launch services on Monday in five big cities to become Poland's second mobile phone operator, Era general manager said.
"We are launching our offer this Monday and we will be the first firm offering digital GSM cellular service in Poland," Tadeusz Kubiak told a news conference on Friday.
Era's entry to the market will break the five-year-old monopoly in cellular services by Centertel SA, a company controlled by Polish state-owned TPSA firm.

Era, in which US West of United States and Deutsche Telecom's subsidiary DeTeMobil hold 22.5 percent stakes each, is one of two consortia that have won a government licence to develop a cellular network operating in digital GSM system.
Centertel, in which France Telecom and the U.S. Ameritech Corp have 24.5 stakes each, uses an older analogue system.
The second consortium with a GSM licence -- Polkomtel SA, which involves Danish cellular telephone operator Tele Danmark and U.S. AirTouch -- plans to start operations soon.

Era's Kubiak said his company would first offer services in the cities of Warsaw, Gdansk, Poznan, Katowice and Krakow. By March 1997, Era should also embrace the cities of Szczecin, Bydgoszcz, Lodz, Wroclaw, Czestochowa and car routes between Warsaw, Poznan and Katowice.
He added Era planned to make GSM services available to 75 percent of Poles by the end of 1997 and wanted to cover all Poland's territory in the next five years.
Era targeted several hundred thousand customers within the next several years, Kubiak said.

Era's other shareholders include Polish trading and industrial conglomerate Elektrim with a 32.5 percent stake while its competitor, Polkomtel, groups KGHM copper combine and Petrochemia Plocka oil refinery.
Kubiak said that Era services would be accessible to German's users of D1 cellular network and Spanish Telefonica Mobiles.
